_comment: Hand-added Rebuilt Games entries that are not in the upstream awesome-decomp-games list. Same shape as rebuilt-games.json; kept separate so the weekly scan never overwrites them. Status is still derived in code (src/lib/rebuilt), so none of these is playable in the browser.

games.title: Animal Crossing (GameCube) for Android
games.description: Native Android port of the Animal Crossing decompilation: the game code runs natively, GX is translated to OpenGL ES 3. Install the APK from the project's Releases, then import your own USA disc image (GAFE01) inside the app. No game data is included. Touch overlay, gamepad, widescreen and HD textures supported.
